summary: Beam Global filed an 8-K on September 22, 2026, disclosing a non-binding letter of intent to acquire a vertically integrated European drone technology company that develops, manufactures, and sells drones plus AI-enhanced software. No purchase price, stake, premium, funding structure, board recommendation, or advisor was named, and Beam is the acquirer. The deal remains subject to due diligence, definitive agreement negotiation, and customary closing conditions, with no assurance of completion. Watch for a definitive agreement filing, terms, financing, and regulatory clearances; failure to sign would remove a potential re-rating catalyst.
